name: Airscale
summary: Find professional and personal emails and mobile numbers, search people and companies, and extract LinkedIn profiles.

api_key.description: An Airscale workspace API key (Settings > API key). Sent as a Bearer token.

notes: Every call is a POST with a JSON body, reads included.
Credits are charged only on success; not_found results are free. Costs are per endpoint (see each).
Rate limits are per endpoint and per workspace (see each); 429 means wait for the window to reset.
A client timeout or 502 does not prove the call was not charged: check the balance before retrying.
Monitors (job change, new hire, post engagement), post scraping and bulk email finding are not in this entry.

endpoints.name: Get credit balance
notes: A read over POST with no body. Free.

endpoints.name: Find a professional email
endpoints.summary: Verified work email from a LinkedIn URL or a name plus company.

linkedin_profile_url.description: LinkedIn person profile URL; enough on its own.

first_name.description: First name (needed with last_name when no profile URL).

notes: A read over POST. 2 credits when found. 3,000 requests a minute.
Without linkedin_profile_url, first_name, last_name and domain or company_name are all required; full_name is not accepted.

endpoints.name: Find a mobile number
endpoints.summary: Mobile phone numbers for a LinkedIn profile.
notes: A read over POST. 40 credits when found. phone_numbers is the primary number, all_phone_numbers the full list. 6,000 requests a minute.

endpoints.name: Find a personal email
endpoints.summary: Personal email address for a LinkedIn profile.

verification.description: true (or "yes") turns on verification; anything else leaves it off.

notes: A read over POST. 3 to 12 credits when found, depending on the source; needs at least 3 credits to start. A 502 can come after a charge. 2,000 requests a minute.

endpoints.name: Search people
endpoints.summary: Leads matching person, role, company and past-experience filters.

query.description: Filters, e.g. {"jobTitle": {"include": ["Founder"]}}; the filter keys are on the docs page.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page, unchanged, with the same query.

notes: A read over POST. 0.1 credit per lead returned; empty pages are free. 6 requests a second.
POST /find-people/count takes the same query and is free.

endpoints.name: Search companies
endpoints.summary: Companies matching firmographic, location, event, intent and technology filters.

filters.description: Filters; valid values come from the company filter-values endpoint (docs page).

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page; its saved size wins.

notes: A read over POST. 0.1 credit per company returned. Cursor paging reaches at most 10,000 companies per search. 6 requests a second.
Booleans such as hasWebsite must be JSON booleans, not strings.

endpoints.name: Extract a LinkedIn person profile
endpoints.summary: Structured profile from a LinkedIn /in/ URL.
notes: A read over POST. 1 credit for an /in/ profile (0.5 for /company/ or /school/); failures are free. 404 means no profile. 3,000 requests a minute.

endpoints.name: Extract a LinkedIn company profile
endpoints.summary: Structured organization profile from a LinkedIn /company/ or /school/ URL.
notes: A read over POST. 0.5 credit when found. 3,000 requests a minute.

endpoints.name: Find a person from an email
endpoints.summary: Person profile behind an email address.
notes: A read over POST. 2 credits when found. A miss is the bare JSON string "not found", free. Profile keys are camelCase and nested (profile.firstName). 25 requests a second.

endpoints.name: Find a company's LinkedIn URL from its domain
endpoints.summary: LinkedIn company URL for a domain.

domain.description: Hostname only, no scheme or path.

idempotency_key.description: Reuse for retries of the same domain: replays for 7 days without a new charge.

notes: A read over POST. 0.5 credit when found; 404 (no match) and 504 (timeout) are free. Takes up to 120 s. 180 requests a minute.
